method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); two regulative rules (s 134AB(7) with (9), s 135A(2D) with (2DB)) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Accident Compensation Act 1985 (Vic), Act No. 10191/1985, Version No. 237 (incorporating amendments as at 2 October 2026), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/accident-compensation-act-1985.txt (committed text sha256 60b465c479904ca0aa9d2d3b991ac9c446624a7e51747b2378d66c7ad32d6dc0), converted from the Word file saved by hand by the owner on 2026-11-06; with the Division 2D figures for 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2027 from the Accident Compensation Act 1985 notice in Victoria Government Gazette No. S 363 of 30 June 2026, deposited at subjects/au/vic/workers-compensation-annual-indexation-notice/registers/source-bundle/GG2026S363.txt (sha256 04c8fe556bca3ef38185cf933965d9a6526da59cac06fb470eec02fe5945499a), lines 9-336, copied into aca-amounts.l4
